predictor_definition: Previous calendar day's active staked native units divided by circulating units inferred from that same day's CoinPaprika market cap / price. Structural controls are zero by design; missing positive-asset stake is never zero.
snapshot: Exact active ETH effective balance at the parent's configured daily 12:00 UTC slot; BNB all-validator pool stake as already collected. No epoch-average, validator-count-times-32, deposit-contract-balance or actual-balance substitution.

outcome_definitions.volume_to_market_cap: CoinPaprika volume_24h_usd / market_cap_usd on outcome date.
outcome_definitions.realized_volatility_30d_annualized: Population standard deviation of 30 consecutive USD log returns from DeFiLlama daily prices, ending on outcome date, times sqrt(365). Requires 31 consecutive prices.
outcome_definitions.drawdown_from_90d_high: Current DeFiLlama USD price divided by maximum of the 90 consecutive calendar prices ending on outcome date, minus one. Requires all 90 prices.

warmup: Use archived pre-window DeFiLlama USD prices for 30/90-day outcome lookbacks. Do not backfill any missing day. First study day lacks a market denominator for the lag unless the preceding calendar day is actually observed.

absorbed_control.btc_log_return: Common across assets on each date and therefore exactly absorbed by date fixed effects; never fit it as an independently identified coefficient.

common_sample: Use identical complete calendar dates for all five primary assets and all three outcomes, at least parent's minimum_common_days. Require complete valid ETH and BNB stake observations for every day in the parent window before any estimation.
estimator: OLS after balanced-panel two-way demeaning; reject singular transformed design.
inference: Null-imposed wild-cluster t bootstrap with Rademacher asset weights, enumerating all 32 assignments for five assets, with CR1 cluster covariance. Exact enumeration is not a finite-sample validity guarantee, particularly with only two stake-positive assets.
multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg correction across exactly three two-sided H4 outcome tests; report raw p and q without treating exploratory thresholds as confirmation.
uncertainty: No calibrated confidence interval or causal interpretation. Report coefficient, effect per 1-percentage-point change in stake share, cluster standard error, 32-sign bootstrap p and BH q. Two-sided p-value grid is at least 2/32 = 0.0625 in nondegenerate cases.
case_study: Legacy stkAAVE remains separate and is not estimated by this primary-panel command.
guardrails: Do not run on partial ETH data or replace it with BNB-only inference.
Do not select outcomes, windows, controls or quote sources based on results.
Turnover is not executable market liquidity; trading volume, prices and staking can respond jointly to other forces.
ETH effective balance measures consensus weight; BNB pool totals use a different chain-specific measurement. Neither measures all inaccessible supply, and liquid staking can leave exposure tradeable.
